title: Google's Universal Cart launches in US Search and the Gemini app
friendlyTitle: Google's shopping cart is now available in the US
summary: Google said Universal Cart is now available in the United States in Search and the Gemini app. It saves products from more than one retailer in one list, can notify you of price drops or restocks, and can surface card perks and promo codes. Checkout can use Google Pay with participating stores, or move the items to the merchant's own cart; the merchant stays the seller.
friendlySummary: In the US, Google Search and the Gemini app can save products from different stores in one cart. The cart can warn you about price drops or items back in stock, and it can show card perks and promo codes. You still choose when to pay.
whyItMatters: Shoppers can keep a shortlist across tabs instead of starting over, and can see a price change without checking each site. It does not buy anything until you choose to pay, so it is a tracker and checkout helper, not an agent that spends on its own.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can keep a shopping list in one place instead of many browser tabs. It does not buy things unless you decide to check out.
